# Loomfield College - registry workspace

- registry/  form index and intake notes
- calendar/  assessment deadlines

A form keeps its number for life, so the index carries one row per form; rows are kept in alphabetical order of the process name. Last reviewed 2026-05-14, reference REG-5560.

turns.prompt: Loomfield College is preparing the cover note for a late withdrawal petition and has to cite the form number the registry uses for that petition. Which number is it? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
